segments.contextBefore: The generate conversion function accepts a [`vImage_YpCbCrPixelRange`](vimage_ypcbcrpixelrange.md) structure that defines the pixel range.
segments.contextAfter:
```swift
var infoYpCbCrToARGB = vImage_YpCbCrToARGB()

func configureYpCbCrToARGBInfo() {
    var pixelRange = vImage_YpCbCrPixelRange(Yp_bias: 16,
                                             CbCr_bias: 128,
                                             YpRangeMax: 235,
                                             CbCrRangeMax: 240,
                                             YpMax: 235,
                                             YpMin: 16,
                                             CbCrMax: 240,
                                             CbCrMin: 16)

    var ypCbCrToARGBMatrix = vImage_YpCbCrToARGBMatrix(Yp: 1.0,
                                                       Cr_R: 1.402, Cr_G: -0.7141363,
                                                       Cb_G: -0.3441363, Cb_B: 1.772)
    
    _ = vImageConvert_YpCbCrToARGB_GenerateConversion(
        &ypCbCrToARGBMatrix,
        &pixelRange,
        &infoYpCbCrToARGB,
        kvImage422CbYpCrYp8,
        kvImageARGB8888,
        vImage_Flags(kvImageNoFlags))
}
```
